grammar_focus: can / could / may / might 的用法(主考:表请求 Can/Could/May I…?——could/might 更委婉 · 表推测'可能'He may come · may/might + have + 过去分词表'可能已经'——对过去的推测)+ 感叹句 What a…! 与 might as well(辅考:What a pity! · might as well = 不妨、还是…的好)
scene: 剧就要开演了,匆匆赶到售票处却被告知票已售完;正巧一名男子来退票,但那两张是下周三的——'我还是买下吧',我丧气地说

grammar_card.title: 说'可以…吗 / 可能…'(can / could / may / might)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲用 can / could / may / might 提出请求('可以…吗')和表示推测('可能…')。请求时 could / might 更委婉;'可能已经…了'用 may/might + have + 过去分词。全用本课句子举例。

rows: 提请求'可以…吗':Can / Could / May / Might I …?
May I have two tickets, please?
could / might 比 can / may 更委婉、更客气
Could I have those two tickets, please?
may / might 表推测'可能、也许'
The play may begin at any moment.
'可能已经…了'= may/might + have + 过去分词

specialRules.rule: 感叹句 What a + 名词:What a pity! 真遗憾!
might as well = 不妨、还是…的好:I might as well take them.

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — When will the writer see the play?

passage: 'The play may begin at any moment,' I said. 'It may have begun already,' Susan answered. I hurried to the box office. 'May I have two tickets, please?' I asked. 'I'm sorry, we've sold out,' the girl said. 'What a pity!' Susan exclaimed. Just then, a man hurried to the box office. 'Can I return these two tickets?' he asked. 'Certainly,' the girl said. I went back to the box office at once. 'Could I have those two tickets, please?' I asked. 'Certainly,' the girl said, 'but they're for next Wednesday's performance. Do you still want them?' 'I might as well have them,' I said sadly.
